zh.text: 短缺與過剩

en.text: A large stock of corn is piling up because of a good harvest. Which of the following diagrams can explain this phenomenon?

zh.text: 由於豐收，粟米大量囤積。以下哪一圖可解釋此現象？

en.text: HKCEE 1992 Paper 2 Q23

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1992 卷二 第 23 題

en.text: It was reported that many people queued for two days in order to get the monthly parking ticket for a certain car park. This phenomenon implies

zh.text: 有報道指不少人排隊兩天以購買某停車場的泊車月票。這現象意味著

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
scarcity in parking spaces.

zh.text: 泊車位屬「稀少性」。

en.text: the existence of competition.

zh.text: 競爭的存在。

en.text: shortage of parking spaces.

zh.text: 泊車位短缺。

en.text: HKCEE 1995 Paper 2 Q1

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1995 卷二 第 1 題

en.text: The Mass Transit Railway Corporation (MTRC) encourages the adoption of a flexi-time office-hours scheme (彈性上班時間) to reduce the overcrowding of passengers during the rush hours. Hence, passengers using the Nathan Road Route before 8:00 a.m. and between 9:00 a.m. and 9:30 a.m. will have a discount on their MTR fares.

zh.text: 香港地下鐵路公司鼓勵實施彈性上班時間計劃，以減低繁忙時間乘客的過份擁擠。因此，彌敦道幹線的乘客在上午 8 時前及在上午 9 時至 9 時 30 分之間乘搭地鐵可獲減價優待。

en.text: Which of the following diagrams could be a result of such a measure of the MTRC?

zh.text: 下列哪一幅圖可能是地下鐵路上述措施的一個結果？

en.text: HKCEE 1997 Paper 2 Q6

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1997 卷二 第 6 題

en.text: When the Real Madrid football team visited Hong Kong, many people queued up for days for the tickets to watch the game. Some people complained that they were unable to buy a ticket even they were willing to pay the official ticket price. This implies that

zh.text: 皇家馬德里足球隊訪港時，很多人為購買球賽門券排隊多天。部分人投訴說即使他們願意付出主辦單位訂定的票價，還是買不到門券。這意味着

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
there was only price competition for the ticket.

zh.text: 購買門券只有價格競爭。

en.text: the official ticket price was set below the market clearing level.

zh.text: 主辦單位訂定的票價低於市場清銷價格。

en.text: the opportunity cost of obtaining a ticket was higher than its official selling price.

zh.text: 獲得一張門券的機會成本高於主辦單位訂定的售價。

en.text: HKCEE 2004 Paper 2 Q13

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2004 卷二 第 13 題

en.text: It was reported that in late 2004, there were millions of unemployed people in the countryside of the Chinese mainland. On the other hand, the firms in the Pearl River delta faced a labour shortage problem.

zh.text: 根據新聞報道，於2004年終，中國內地的農村有數以百萬計的人失業。另一方面，珠江三角洲的廠商則有勞工短缺問題。

en.text: Which of the following would reduce unemployment in the countryside?

zh.text: 下列哪項會減少農村的失業人口？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
The social welfare benefit of workers in the Pearl River delta improves.

zh.text: 在珠江三角洲，工人的社會福利保障有所改善。

en.text: Labour wages in the Pearl River delta fall.

zh.text: 珠江三角洲的工資下降。

en.text: Firms in the Pearl River delta move to the countryside.

zh.text: 珠江三角洲的廠商搬往農村生產。

en.text: HKCEE 2005 Paper 2 Q6

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2005 卷二 第 6 題

en.text: While many construction workers are unemployed in Hong Kong, there is a shortage of construction workers in Macau. Suppose a law is passed in Macau which allows the importation of construction workers from Hong Kong to Macau. Which of the following diagrams would best describe the effects of such a law on the labour market of construction workers in Macau?

zh.text: 當香港有很多建築工人失業，澳門的建築業卻有工人短缺問題。假設澳門通過一條法例容許澳門從香港輸入建築工人，則關於該法例對澳門建築業的勞工市場的影響，下列哪一幅圖會是最佳的描述？

en.text: HKCEE 2005 Paper 2 Q7

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2005 卷二 第 7 題

en.text: Many people queued up for days for the tickets to watch the show of Tsz-Wah, a famous artist performing stand-up comedy. Some people complained that they were unable to buy tickets even though they were willing to pay the ticket price set by the organiser. The above situation implies that

zh.text: 很多人連日排隊買票觀看著名藝人子華的棟篤笑表演。有些人投訴即使他們願意支付主辦機構所訂的門票價格，他們仍買不到門票。上述情況意味著

en.text: price was the only criterion for allocating the tickets.

zh.text: 價格是分配門票的唯一準則。

en.text: the producer was not maximising its profit.

zh.text: 生產商沒有爭取最高利潤。

en.text: a black market for the tickets might emerge.

zh.text: 有可能出現黑市門票。

en.text: there was an effective price ceiling in the ticket market.

zh.text: 門票市場存在有效的價格上限。

en.text: HKDSE 2015 Paper 1 Q13

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2015 卷一 第 13 題

en.text: The average waiting time for public housing is 4.7 years according to the data from the Housing Authority. Which of the following would lead to an increase in the waiting time for public housing in the long term?

zh.text: 根據房委會的資料，公屋平均輪候時間為 4.7 年。下列哪項長遠來說會令公屋輪候時間增加？

en.text: a financial aid offered to low-income families renting private residential flats

zh.text: 向租住私人住宅的低收入家庭提供金錢補助

en.text: a rise in the income limit of applying for public housing

zh.text: 提高申請公屋的人息限額

en.text: a relaxation of rules regulating the change of land use

zh.text: 放寬規管改變土地用途的規例

en.text: a provision of shared-housing units by a billionaire for the applicants of Comprehensive Social Security Assistance Scheme

zh.text: 某億萬富翁為綜合社會保障援助計劃的申請者提供共享房屋

en.text: HKDSE 2018 Paper 1 Q15

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2018 卷一 第 15 題

en.text: As part of the 'Happy Hong Kong' campaign, the 'Hong Kong Cinema Day' was held in April 2023, with tickets priced at HK$30 across all participating cinemas. It was reported that many people failed to buy any discounted film ticket even after queuing up for hours.

zh.text: 作為「開心香港」活動的一部分，「全港戲院日」在 2023 年 4 月舉行，參與活動的戲院的電影票價一律為 $30。有報道指，很多人即使排隊輪候數小時，仍未能購得優惠戲票。

en.text: From the information above, we can infer that the quantity transacted of the discounted film tickets is

zh.text: 從以上資料可以推斷，該些優惠戲票的交易量______。

zh.text: 等於其供應量而小於其需求量
